## Project Context
- Zero-dependency embedded observability toolkit for Java libraries & microservices.
- Shaded packaging guarantees zero host application classpath pollution.
- Pre-allocated lock-free `MetricRingBuffer` ensures zero allocation on hot path.
- In-memory `GraphMetricAggregator` dynamically tracks execution causality, p95 latencies, and exception cascades.
- Embedded JDK `HttpServer` exposes live telemetry and topology graphs at `http://localhost:9090`.
